name: West Coast Cubing Tour: San Diego 2025
information:
Join us for the San Diego leg of the West Coast Cubing Tour!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzA0OTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--310605b25b0ecf790ae7a5eddc8b532d6493cd85/WCCT2.PNG)
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCTSanDiego2025#43196-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
